description: This Java class defines a LoRaWAN provider implementation for Kerlink devices within the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides methods to identify provider-specific details and to extract device identifiers and payload data from incoming LoRa messages encoded as JSON objects.

classes.name: KerlinkProvider
classes.description: A provider implementation for Kerlink LoRaWAN devices, implementing the LoraProvider interface and defining provider-specific constants and methods.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the provider, which is 'kerlink'.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Provides the URI path prefix for Kerlink receiver messages.

methods.name: acceptedContentType
methods.description: Returns the expected Content-Type header value for Kerlink JSON messages.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device identifier (EUI) from the provided JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload data from the 'userdata' field within the JSON message.
